summary: Backcountry skier (first name John) crashed head-first into a rock at Mayflower Gulch after his ski clipped a rock at the bottom of a run; helmet cracked and caved across the front right half, with head/neck/back pain and confusion. Summit County Search & Rescue heli-evacuated him to Summit Medical during a weather window; he underwent surgery for compression fractures in the middle back and lower neck.
notes: First-person account by the party that found the skier and called 911 (single personal-blog source; incident dated 'March 17th' in the text, page published 2023-03-19). MERGED/INSERTED run 987.
